Zone B · stack position

The Eight Faces of Ne

The canvas draws Ne as a branching tree: one stimulus in, many possibilities out. Where Ne sits in a person's stack — the fixed order their eight functions come in — changes how it branches. Click a position to see the change, from the dominant's omnidirectional bloom to the demon's hostile what-ifs, and watch the live-branch count: it tells the story before the caption does. Drag the maturity slider to watch the lower seats gain fidelity with age.

Zone C · feeder coupling

What Feeds Into Ne?

Ne gathers; it does not judge. Extraverted perception is fed by introverted judgment, so its real partners are the inner judges — Ti and Fi, the functions that decide which branches deserve to live. Click a feeder to watch what grows.

Zone D · the divergence engine

The Divergence Engine

Ne branches one stimulus into many possibilities, in public, at speed. This lab exposes the divergence engine's live state — stress, pleasure, breadth, open threads — and five ways a day can treat it. Trigger a scenario and watch the telemetry answer.
